headline: Bank of Japan Releases Minutes from September Monetary Policy Meeting
summary: The Bank of Japan has published the minutes from its monetary policy meeting held on September 17 and 18, 2026.
why: The Bank of Japan is the central bank of Japan, responsible for setting interest rates and managing monetary policy, which significantly influences the yen and Japanese government bond yields.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Central bank minutes provide insight into future interest rate trajectories.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Market participants analyze central bank minutes to gauge the likelihood of future interest rate adjustments, which directly impacts currency valuations and bond yields.
